title: Luma Diagnostics Form 8-K settlement disclosure
bodyText:
UNITED STATES
FORM 8-K
Item 8.01 Other Events.
On May 11, 2026, Luma Diagnostics disclosed that it entered into a settlement agreement to resolve pending litigation related to prior product warranties. The Company will pay $18.5 million and will record a charge in the second quarter. The settlement does not include any admission of liability.
